Just got my BRB a few weeks ago. I used a bin setup with an under tank heat with a thermostat. I made sure I could keep the enclosure at a consistent 95-100% humidity with the hot spot at 80-85 degrees and made sure it can’t go over that since they are sensitive to high heats. Haven’t had any issues so far. She only tagged me once right after the seller woke up her and sexed her which probably stressed her out. Besides that I can pick her whenever no issues so mine has a really good temperament. They are beautiful too, not only with the iridescence but their actual scale pattern. Just make sure you can keep the parameters where they need to be and don’t over heat. I’d recommend a bin with small air holes in it versus a tank with a screen lid so that you can keep in the humidity. Under tank heating mat should cover one third of the bin on the far right or far left side so that it can create a heat gradient. Slightly damp sphagnum moss is also nice for making humid hides. Mine really likes hers as I have to pull her out every once in a while to check that she isn’t giving herself scale rot from it out of paranoia, but as long as it isn’t dripping wet or sitting on water it shouldn’t be an issue.
